Please guide us as per Shariah the earnings (haram or halal) of those ladies tailor who earns by stiching the dresses of girls/womens which is against the Islamic Shariah like Choli/Blouse (as per Indian culture which shows the skin of waist or upper chest, etc) or any tight salwar/kameez which expose the structure of the lady. 2) If it is haram, also guide us whether it is haram in the state of she/he had no source of income other than tailoring. 3) If it is haram, can the relatives of them avoid eatings from their income. 4031 views Q. Whether I can sell a property on installments at a higher price if the payment is to made at a later date? 2040 views Q. My cousin is having a business. I like to invest in his business. He agrees to share returns every year based on profit and loss of the company but does not want to include me as a partner officially in the company. Therefore although for all practical purposes I will be a deemed partner in the company there will be no official record for the same. As per the governmant rules only partners are entitiles to share in the profit and loss of the company. To overcome this legal hurdle my cousin offers to give me my share of profit in the name of "interest" although actually it is my share of profit and not acutally riba. If there is loss in the company I would not receive any returns and will share in the the loss. Please advise whether this arrangement is OK and not contrary to the principles of Shariah. 1796 views Q. I am a commerce graduate. ihave worked in hospital for 3 years due to some family problems, therefore ihave sound knowledge of application of primary medicine of allopathic including many antibiotics. Unfortunately i haven't any certificate by recognised institutes. My Question is that one can run allopathic dispensary like me without any certificate of any institutes recognised under the rule of Govt. of India , where it is prohibited in India. Is it allowable in the view of Islam? 1594 views Q. I am a transporter. A company has aproached me to pull their trailer with my truck. The trailer will be filled with Haraam meat products. Is this allowed? 2. I have bought my business from a reputible Mufti. He has charged me goodwill for the business. Is this allowed? 2348 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 14775 Country: India Title: asalamoualikum mufti sahab there is a person in our locality who does business in rice which he is telling and loots of people and who understand islam properly r investing in it (muslim men and women)i wanted to clarify some doubts about the same. 1)The minimum share is of RS 50,000 and if u invest RS 50000 u get profit of RS 1000 PLUS MINUS RS100 TO RS300 per month. profit is not fixed we get money on montly baisis. 1)so is it halal or haram as we always get some money every month to be clear there is no loose only less or more then 1000RS(RS100-RS300). 2)HE says TO us that u can visit our gowdon and c the rice stock. 3)please let me know mufti sahab if we should invest in that business or not. Question: asalamoualikum mufti sahab there is a person in our locality who does business in rice which he is telling and loots of people and who understand islam properly r investing in it (muslim men and women)i wanted to clarify some doubts about the same. 1)The minimum share is of RS 50,000 and if u invest RS 50000 u get profit of RS 1000 PLUS MINUS RS100 TO RS300 per month. profit is not fixed we get money on montly baisis. 1)so is it halal or haram as we always get some money every month to be clear there is no loose only less or more then 1000RS(RS100-RS300). 2)HE says TO us that u can visit our gowdon and c the rice stock. 3)please let me know mufti sahab if we should invest in that business or not. Answer ID: 14775 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1665/1335=H/1430) Your doubts are substantial; therefore you should not invest in the business. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
